mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the GDP growth condition is met, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over two consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the PAYEMS growth condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS growth and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% within a month signals inflationary pressure, which leads to tighter monetary policy and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and decrease in retail and food services sales signals a shift in consumer spending towards non-discretionary items, indicating economic uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS changes on negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
